EmailTemplate.description: SignZero final reminder email. Edit freely, or clone it and set the copy in SignZero Email Templates. Keep the [[...]] placeholders SignZero fills in; see the technical guide.
EmailTemplate.name: SignZero Final reminder
EmailTemplate.subject: Final reminder: Review & Sign [[DocumentName]]
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello [[SignerName]],
[[CompanyName]] is still waiting for you to review and sign "[[DocumentName]]".
Open your secure signing session: [[SigningLink]]
This is the last reminder you will get. This link is personal to you and expires on [[ExpiresOn]]. Do not forward it. [[NewLinkNote]]
